_: 简体中文 KEY TEXT. Authored 2026-09-11 NATIVELY from Dreame's own Simplified Chinese manuals — no English>zh hop. zh_hans is almost certainly the SOURCE language of this corpus, so these strings are lifted from the vendor's own sentences rather than translated back into them. Sources, all in manuals/language-source/_text/: zh_hans-roller (roller, robot used-water box, washboard + heating module), zh_hans-track (track, washboard filter), zh_hans-matrix (Matrix10: station door, 拖布盘, slots), zh_hans-pad / zh_hans-cloth (shared tail, dust bin, brushes, sensors, dock tanks). CAVEAT ON TWO BUCKETS: zh_hans-pad and zh_hans-cloth are BYTE-IDENTICAL (md5 673c7422…), and that single document is neither a pad machine nor a tank-in-module cloth machine — it is a MOVA G30 Ultra, a dock-washed flat mop (拖布支架 + 主机污水盒 + 刮水槽). Its shared / robot / dock content is first-party and is used here; its mop content is neither mechanism. So the pad nouns (拖布盘 / 拖布) come from the vendor's own Chinese edition of the SELECTED pad document, x50-pad__zh_hant, and the cloth nouns (拖地模组, 注水盖上的回气孔) from d20-cloth__zh_hk — same vendor, same language, Traditional glyphs only. 拖布盘 is independently confirmed in Simplified by zh_hans-matrix.
_register: THE VENDOR'S OWN SPLIT, TAKEN VERBATIM. Steps are BARE IMPERATIVE, no subject and no 您 (「取出污水箱，倒掉里面的污水。」); notes and prohibitions take 请 + verb (「请勿使用刷子、手指或尖锐物品…」). Every zh_hans manual read here does exactly this, and NONE of them uses 您 anywhere. So the eight note keys carry 请 / 请勿 and the step keys do not — the single exception is heating.descale_when_cool_if_fitted, whose conditional burn clause and prohibition ARE the vendor's own note text. Chinese has no gender and no inflection, so the agreement problem that forced the object-free rule on German cannot arise here — the rule is kept anyway, because a shared key must read correctly under ANY panel heading: 「仅用清水冲洗干净。」 is true over 主刷, 滤网, 万向轮, 拖布 and 水箱 alike. No 它/其 appears in any shared key. service.return_to_dock and service.return_to_service name 主机, by design.
_vocabulary: Dreame's own Simplified Chinese, taken from the parts tables and maintenance headings rather than invented: 主机 (robot) · 基站 (base station) · 尘盒 (dust bin) · 尘盒滤网 (dust bin filter) · 主刷 (main brush) · 主刷罩 (brush guard) · 边刷 (side brush) · 万向轮 (omnidirectional wheel) · 主轮 (main wheels) · 拖布 (mop pad) · 拖布盘 (mop pad holder / carriage — robot-side on x50-pad, dock-side on Matrix10) · 拖布组件 (mop assembly: roller + track) · 拖布支架 (mop bracket) · 拖布组件腔体 (mop compartment) · 拖地模组 (mopping module, cloth) · 注水盖上的回气孔 (air hole in the fill cap) · 污水箱 (dirty water tank) · 清水箱 (clean water tank) · 主机污水盒 (robot used-water box) · 浮球 (float ball) · 清洗盘 (washboard) · 清洗盘滤网 (washboard filter) · 加热组件 (heating module) · 基站底盘 (base station tray) · 基站舱门 (station door) · 仓位 (slot) · 充电弹片 (dock charging contacts) · 信号发射区 (signal area) · 机身插孔 (the slot that self-rotates) · 常温 (room temperature) · 除垢剂 (descaler).
access.brush_guard: 取下主刷罩，向上取出主刷。
access.dust_bin: 打开主机面盖，取出尘盒。
contacts.dock_side_too: 基站上的充电弹片和信号发射区也照此擦拭干净。
filter.remove_and_tap: 取出尘盒滤网，轻拍滤网边框将灰尘敲落。
mop.cloth_module_off: 从主机上取下拖地模组。
mop.cloth_pad_off_module: 将拖布从拖地模组上取下，两者都要清洗干净。
mop.cloth_pour_out_water: 先倒出拖地模组中残留的水，再做后面的步骤。
mop.compartment_and_filter: 清理拖布组件腔体和腔体内的滤网，避免堵塞。
mop.holders_remove: 将拖布盘从各自的仓位中取出。
mop.holders_to_corresponding_slots: 将每个拖布盘装回原来的仓位。基站按仓位取用拖布，装错仓位就会把错误的拖布送到错误的房间，而且不会有任何提示。
mop.pad_clean_all_four: 两块拖布和两个拖布盘，四个部件都要清洗干净。
mop.pad_off_carriage: 将每块拖布从拖布盘上揭下。
mop.pads_off_holders_and_clean: 将拖布从拖布盘上揭下，两者都要清洗干净。颜色是配套的，每块拖布对应同色的拖布盘。
mop.roller_release_and_lift: 将拖布组件从腔体中取出。
mop.track_detach_from_bracket: 将拖布从拖布支架上取下。
mop.track_hair_in_bracket: 清理拖布支架上缠绕的毛发，不只是拖布上的。
mop.track_release_assembly: 从主机上取下拖布组件。
note.filter_no_brush_finger_sharp: 请勿使用刷子、手指或尖锐物品清理滤网，以免损坏滤网。
note.no_detergent: 仅用清水清洗，请勿添加任何洗涤剂。
note.see_user_manual: 详细说明和警告请参阅使用说明书。
note.side_brush_do_not_yank: 毛发缠得很紧时，请将其拨松或剪断，不要用力硬拽，以免损坏边刷。
note.wet_cloth_damages_sensors: 清理时请使用干抹布；请勿使用湿抹布，以防进水造成损坏。
rinse.bin_and_filter_clean_water: 仅用清水冲洗尘盒和滤网。
side.rinse_if_soiled: 边刷沾上潮湿或粘稠的脏污时，用清水冲洗干净，并充分晾干后再装回。
tool.remove_tangled_hair: 清理缠绕的毛发，用手取不下时可借助合适的工具。
washboard.allow_cooling_before_service: 如果基站配有清洗盘加热组件，请预留充裕的时间，待其完全冷却后再进行维护。
washboard.filter_if_fitted: 如果基站配有清洗盘滤网，也一并冲洗干净并装回。
washboard.remove: 将清洗盘从基站中取出。
washboard.wipe_base: 将下方的基站底盘擦拭干净。
wheel.omnidirectional_remove: 将轮子从主机底部拔出。
wheel.wipe_other_wheels: 用干布擦拭主轮和底部的其他轮子。
wipe.compartment_soft_dry_cloth: 用柔软干布将空出的腔体擦拭干净。
